prompt:
You describe a timing diagram from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. Every signal, from top to bottom.
2. The sequence of edges and states in time order, and which edge triggers which.
3. Every named interval (for example tSU, tH) with its value and unit, if shown.

Figure type: timing diagram
Section: 5.4 Host-Command Interface (LR20xx) > 5.4.1 Read Write Command > 5.4.1.2 Read Commands
Caption: Figure 5-3: Read Command
Text inside the figure (exact, from the PDF text layer): BUSY | NSS | MOSI Op(15:8) Op(7:0) Arg0 0 0 0 | MISO Stat(15:8) Stat(7:0) Irq(31:24) Stat(15:8) Stat(7:0) Rsp1 | SPI
Text that mentions the figure: Once the LR2021/LR2022/LR2012 has finished preparing the requested data, it de-asserts the BUSY pin, signalling the completion of the operation. At this point, the Host controller can read back the data by sending 0x00 or any other appropriate value to shift out the data on the SPI.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Timing diagram of Figure 5-3: Read Command.

Signals from top to bottom are: BUSY, NSS, MOSI, MISO, and SPI.

The sequence of edges and states in time order is as follows:
- BUSY starts high.
- NSS starts high.
- MOSI starts low.
- MISO starts low.
- SPI starts low.
- BUSY transitions low.
- NSS transitions low.
- MOSI transitions high, followed by Op(15:8), Op(7:0), and Arg0.
- MISO transitions high, followed by Stat(15:8), Stat(7:0), and Irq(31:24).
- MOSI transitions low, followed by 0, 0, and 0.
- MISO transitions low, followed by Stat(15:8) and Stat(7:0).
- MOSI transitions high, followed by 0.
- MISO transitions high, followed by Rsp1.
- NSS transitions high.
- BUSY transitions high.

There are no named intervals with values and units shown in the diagram.
